notes: QA audit batch 3 fixes (v1.11.25, report §14): BUG-020 an ambiguous exact (date+start+title) match no longer creates a duplicate box — the event is skipped entirely (it stays in last_feed, so the reconnect picker can still suggest it); BUG-021 delete + recreate in Google no longer splits history silently — the reconnect picker pre-matches the recreated event to the orphaned box (same date+start, exactly one candidate whose box holds no user data) with a one-click «looks like the same task — move history?» row, and the reconnect menu is enabled for that box even when no unlinked events exist; the existing reconnect path absorbs the empty pull-created duplicate, so the old box keeps its ticks/tests/minutes; BUG-023 Analytics daily analysis attributes actual/useful minutes by timer-session execution day (session start study day, 03:30 rule) instead of the box's planned day — a session run past midnight counts on the day it ran; manual entries, undated sessions and the live timer fall back to the box day; anAgg and the charts keep box-day attribution by design; BUG-024 a corrupt calendar_data.json with no verified backup no longer silently falls back to the shipped seed (which dropped every Google link) — load_programme raises ProgrammeCorruptError, the sync fails loudly in the sync log and the HTTP layer answers 500 with the message; the corrupt file is still preserved as .corrupt-<ts>; BUG-025 google_push_state.json now has a backup and recovery like the other stores — create_backup gains a fourth kind 'push', load_push_state preserves a corrupt file and restores the newest verified push backup, save_push_state snapshots on every save, and /api/backup/restore accepts 'push' (restoring push bookkeeping never wipes it via _invalidate_push_tracking); BUG-026 three server errors are mapped in errText instead of showing as raw Persian in English mode — 'B2 تنظیم نشده است', 'در فایل هیچ رویداد درسی پیدا نشد', and the Gemini prefixes 'خطای سرور جمینای: HTTP ' and 'ارتباط با جمینای برقرار نشد: '; BUG-028 the auto-update trust anchor is the official repo, not just the raw.githubusercontent.com host — fetch_manifest pins the manifest URL to ParhammPm/studyflow/main/latest.json and validate_manifest requires the zip URL under ParhammPm/studyflow/main/releases/ (the manual /api/update/url path is untouched — the user's explicit choice); BUG-029 an open three-dot box menu no longer stays in the old language after a language switch — applyLang closes it (one tap reopens it). Known totals unchanged: حسابان 3489, شیمی 3000; گسسته and فیزیک have none (2110 not reintroduced). The 1.11.18 examDateText live-computation fix is untouched.
